name: Gordon Wendham
summary: In the Undercity's Trade Quarter, Gordon Wendham sells weapons and helps couriers from the surface find their way.

sections.title: Armaments of the Trade Quarter
sections.body: Gordon Wendham sells weapons to those who take up arms for the Forsaken. His stock ranges from daggers and hand axes to broadswords and maces. Fledgling fighters can find dependable iron here before they venture into the contested reaches of Lordaeron.

sections.title: A Courier's Destination
sections.body: Travelers sent by flight masters and couriers are often directed to Gordon Wendham's stall. Some arrive from the bat handlers atop the ruins. His place in the Trade Quarter makes him easy to find when travelers need supplies or have dispatches to carry through the underground city.

faq.answer: Gordon Wendham sells weapons in the Undercity's Trade Quarter and helps couriers arriving from the surface.
You can find Gordon Wendham at his weapon stall in the Trade Quarter, within the Undercity's underground halls.
He sells basic weapons, including swords, daggers, maces, staves, axes and thrown weapons.
Gordon Wendham receives deliveries from the surface bat roosts, including deliveries from bat handler Michael Garrett.

angles.text: As a Forsaken newly freed from Deathknell, you can find merchants like Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter, supplying the young nation's war effort.
As a warrior, you can buy dependable basic blades and blunt weapons from Gordon Wendham to practice your weapon skills in the capital.
